verdicts.reason: For a Valhallarama capture of the registered black rook Common or Garden, firewormDefender.ts returns no texture and Batch5Presenter.ts:44 draws the fallback ellipse; independently transforming the contact asset at the current position and rotation finds zero blade pixels inside that ellipse, while the star is above it.

The legal Hooligan pawn capture in the consecutive Librarian contact frames shows one sword reaching the shield while the other ends above the defender throughout the held contact; the approved proposal specifies readable two-blade contact.

For reduced-motion playback, Batch5Presenter.ts:56-60 selects only pose 1 and then the last pose; for Valhallarama and the Librarian those are the airborne action and guard rather than their contact poses, so the corrected contact is never shown.
